recipes.name: Homemade Everything Bagel Seasoning
ingredients: 1 tsp sea salt flakes (, or halve for cooking salt / kosher salt (table salt not recommended, too fine))
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Store in a very airtight container for 6 to 8 weeks.
Sprinkle onto bagels or other breads (before baking), or as a finishing salt for "everything", from scrambled eggs to roasted vegetables, avocado toast to hummus!

page_recipe_notes: Recipe Notes: 1. Garlic and onion flakes are little flakes, not to be confused with powder which is much finer and powdery, too fine for this seasoning. You can get onion flakes at Australia grocery stores (Coles, Woolies, Harris Farms) and garlic flakes at Harris Farms, or both are carried atIndian/sub-continent stores. Otherwise, substitute garlic with granules which is very nearly as good, which is carried at regular Australia grocery stores.
